v2-13.candidate: This was the priest’s right from the people, from anyone sacrificing: the priest’s servant would come when the meat was boiling, with a three-pronged meat hook in his hand,

v2-33.candidate: Yet I will spare a man of yours at My altar, so that his eyes fail and his soul ebbs away. Everyone remaining in your house will fall by the sword of men.
v2-33.close: Yet I will not destroy a man of yours from My altar, so that his eyes fail and his soul ebbs away. Everyone remaining in your house will fall by the sword of men.

v2-3.display:
Do not boast, and do not speak loftily;
let no grandiose speech come from your mouth.
For the Lord is a God of knowledge,
and a God who prepares His undertakings.

v2-4.display:
The bow of the mighty has grown weak,
but those who were weak have girded themselves with strength.

v2-5.display:
Those who were full of bread have been diminished,
but the hungry have left the land.
For the barren woman has borne seven,
while she who had many children has grown weak.

v2-8.display:
He raises the needy from the earth
and lifts the poor from the dung heap,
to seat them with rulers of peoples
and grant them a throne of glory as their inheritance,

v2-10.display:
The Lord will weaken His opponent;
the Lord is holy.
Let the wise person not boast in his wisdom,
nor the mighty person in his might,
nor the rich person in his riches.
Rather, let the one who boasts boast in this:
understanding and knowing the Lord,
and doing judgment and righteousness in the midst of the earth.
The Lord ascended into the heavens and thundered.
He will judge the earth’s extremities,
and He gives strength to our kings
and will raise high the horn of His anointed.”
